lines.text: Welcome to Waymark. I’m Nour; I light the lamps here. This line always says what to do next.
Up top: your level, your gold and gems, and your streak, the days in a row you’ve met your daily goal.
Every building is a place you can go into. I’ll show you each one when it’s useful.

lines.intro:board: The Notice Board has today’s quests. Finish them for gold, and a chest now and then.
lines.intro:fellowship: Your friend is in town. Your House has a door to the Fellowship: see what they’re up to.
lines.intro:market: You’ve earned enough for something at the Market. Have a look.
lines.intro:wardrobe: New gear goes on in Your House, at the wardrobe.
lines.intro:other-hall: The other hall’s door is open too, whenever you’re curious.
lines.intro:arena: Up at the Arena, friends challenge each other. Yours might be waiting.
lines.intro:ledger: Your House keeps a ledger of how far you’ve come, and your trophies.

board.title: The Notice Board
board.text: Today’s quests and daily goal are posted here, with the contracts that pay gold. Chests you’ve earned wait on the shelf.

market.title: The Market
market.text: Four wares are set out each day, the same for everyone. Gold buys gear for your traveler, or a gift for a friend.

house.title: Your House
house.text: The wardrobe changes how your traveler looks, and the ledger shows how far you’ve come. Your trophies are here too, and the door to the Fellowship.

arena.title: The Arena
arena.text: Challenge a friend to beat your score, or take on one they’ve sent you. A challenge waits a week for its answer.
